title: Polynomial register bound
statement: For all natural numbers $cS$, $F$, and $n$, if $\ell(n)$ is one plus the length of the binary representation of $n$ and $K_*=2^{F\ell(n)}$, then $n+\ell(n)+(cS+F)\ell(n)+2K_*+2\le(cS+F+6+2\cdot4^F)(n+1)^{F+1}$.
